SELECT co.name AS company_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = 'closed_won' AND d.closed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS deals_closed, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS invoices_sent, COALESCE(SUM(i.total) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.paid_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0) AS revenue_this_week, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'done' AND t.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS tasks_completed FROM companies co LEFT JOIN sales_deals d ON d.company_id = co.id LEFT JOIN sales_invoices i ON i.company_id = co.id LEFT JOIN ops_tasks t ON t.company_id = co.id GROUP BY co.id, co.name ORDER BY co.name
UPDATE system_jobs SET status = 'done', completed_at = NOW(), result = '{"report_sent": true}'::jsonb WHERE name = 'reporting' AND status = 'running' AND started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
